Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the

OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 11. Bidder Should submit local address proof alongwith supporting documents. Buyer reserve rights to rejec t the bid non submission of the requisite documents. 3. Delivery Timeline 3.1 Complete delivery within 15 days from date of supply order. 3.2 Delay may attract LD (Liquidated Damages) as per GeM rules. 4. Packaging Standards 4.1 Items must be supplied in proper original packaging (Pkt/ Box/ Ream as applicable). 4.2 Damaged or loose items will be rejected. 5. Inspection Clause 5.1 Items will be inspected at consignee location. 5.2 Substandard or mismatched items will be rejected and replaced at vendor cost. 6. Replacement Warranty 6.1 Any defective or poor-quality items must be replaced within 7 days. 7. Experience Criteria 7.1 Vendor should have prior experience of supplying Cleaning and Sanitation items to Govt/PSU/Defence ( at least 10 order) 8. OEM/ Auhorized Supplier 9.1 Vendor should be OEM or authorized dealer/ distributor of listed brands. 10. Bidder should submit financial standing cert duly signed by Notary and bank authority. t the requisite documents buyer reserve rights to reject the bid. 11. Bidder should supply the similar product at consignee location. .
